title: Get faster feedback on the seven phone-board checks

intentCoverage.report:
**Caught.** At `2c6f9fe0955bd773e2eaf4f0a7a6e47d15e42fc1`, the published phone-board E2E check caught a regression in the vertical reading promise for `SEED-404#run-dashboard-frontend-checks-at-doughnut-speed`. The maintained check passed with the long Backlog at 390 × 844. Changing the Board view’s `touch-action` from `pan-y pinch-zoom` to `pan-x pinch-zoom` made its `touchAction()` assertion fail with the altered computed value. The maintained fixture and assertion stayed intact. [Story](https://github.com/terryyin/open-dough/blob/2c6f9fe0955bd773e2eaf4f0a7a6e47d15e42fc1/.planning/seeds/SEED-404-run-dashboard-frontend-checks-at-doughnut-speed.md#run-dashboard-frontend-checks-at-doughnut-speed) · [CSS](https://github.com/terryyin/open-dough/blob/2c6f9fe0955bd773e2eaf4f0a7a6e47d15e42fc1/dashboard/src/board.css#L20-L21) · [Maintained assertion](https://github.com/terryyin/open-dough/blob/2c6f9fe0955bd773e2eaf4f0a7a6e47d15e42fc1/e2e/navigation/phone-board.spec.ts#L37-L42)

A separate scratch witness applied the same native vertical stroke to the settled Backlog in each version. With the original CSS, the computed value included `pan-y` and the reading region moved from 0 to 225 px. With the fault, the computed value included `pan-x` and the reading region stayed at 0 px. Restoration matched the pre-probe Git state. The maintained E2E passed again, and the scratch checkout was removed. [Baseline witness](/private/tmp/dough-intent-coverage-404.vlFtKK/baseline-witness.log) · [Fault witness](/private/tmp/dough-intent-coverage-404.vlFtKK/fault-witness.log) · [Maintained failure](/private/tmp/dough-intent-coverage-404.vlFtKK/fault.log) · [Restored proof](/private/tmp/dough-intent-coverage-404.vlFtKK/restored.json)

**Next proof action.** Keep the existing vertical-panning assertion. This probe calls for no additional proof follow-up on this path.

- **Test runtime.** The maintained E2E case took 2.532 s at baseline, 2.425 s with the fault, and 2.902 s after restoration. The respective runner durations were 6.552 s, 5.863 s, and 5.937 s, measured from the runner’s proof records. The baseline and fault witness runs took 4.6 s and 5.1 s, measured by the line reporter.
- **Human effort.** Unavailable. No human effort measure was recorded.
- **Agent effort.** Unavailable. Active agent effort was not measured independently of command waits.


- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 218512 ms (measured), from 1795012845000 to 1795013063512 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.

**Wrap-up disposition.** Checked `2c6f9fe0955bd773e2eaf4f0a7a6e47d15e42fc1`. Caught. Keep the maintained vertical-panning assertion with no additional proof follow-up.
